name: doodo
description: Doodo — offline-first personal calendar & life management platform

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend exec -- tsx --tsconfig frontend/tsconfig.app.json --test frontend/tests/timeline.test.ts frontend/tests/search.test.ts frontend/tests/festivals.test.ts frontend/tests/tools.test.ts
